positive_direction_definition: relative wheel rotation that produces +X forward rolling when body pitch is held fixed

prediction.sign_prediction_basis: The raw TIM4 counter polarity for the project-defined physical positive direction is intentionally unknown. Legacy software negated Read_Encoder(2), but that software convention is not accepted physical sign evidence for the current reference assembly.

forbidden_interpretations: Do not infer physical sign from legacy controller algebra.
Do not infer counts per revolution from the conflicted legacy 13-line / 19:1 arithmetic.
Do not infer encoder_max_abs_delta_counts_per_sample from slow manual rotation.
Do not change estimator, controller, or actuator signs to make the capture look expected.
